_comment: Coverage-gate-v2 floor (verbara-meta/ADR-0013), verbara-website variant — closes ADR-0014 §2 G3. Manual ratchet, no CI write-back. Read from vitest v8 coverage-summary.json by scripts/check-coverage-floor.py (json path) and scripts/check-patch-coverage.py (lcov.info). Two-sided band on line: fail if measured < line OR measured > line + slack (stale floor -> raise 'line' to floor(measured) in the same PR). 'branch' and 'lines_valid_min' are hard lower bounds; 'patch' is the diff-coverage floor. The redundant vitest.config.ts thresholds (lines 86 / functions 90 / branches 84 / statements 86) STAY as a fast-fail liveness backstop. The unit tier scopes coverage to the non-Astro logic only: the scripts validators, the Cloudflare Pages Functions, and src/{drift-detection,i18n/utils}.ts. The two .mjs CLIs' main()/entry-guard are '/* c8 ignore */'-excluded (unit-tested via their pure exported functions), so the measured denominator is the testable logic. Values honest as of the 2026-07-21 baseline run: line 97.71%, branch 93.51%, lines.total 307. Band [line, line+slack] = [96, 99] brackets the measured 97.71.
